data.one_liner: A Dart benchmark harness for measuring code performance
data.what_it_does: Provides BenchmarkBase and AsyncBenchmarkBase classes to run microbenchmarks and report average runtimes. It also offers a command-line tool to execute benchmarks across different Dart runtimes.
use_when: measuring performance of small functions or algorithms
comparing JIT vs AOT or JS/wasm builds
avoid_when: production code that needs to run in the app
performance testing that requires external services or UI interactions
strengths: Simple API, no code generation needed
Supports both sync and async benchmarks
weaknesses: Only works for Dart, not for Flutter widgets
Benchmark results can be affected by system load
